parameters.query: SELECT p.id AS post_id, p.external_id AS media_id, t.access_token FROM posts p, tokens t WHERE p.platform = 'instagram' AND p.status = 'published' AND t.platform = 'instagram' AND COALESCE(t.access_token, '') <> '' AND p.posted_at >= now() - interval '30 days' AND COALESCE(p.external_id, '') <> '' ORDER BY p.posted_at DESC LIMIT 20;

SELECT json_build_object(
  'funnel', (SELECT json_agg(x) FROM (SELECT status, COUNT(*)::int AS n FROM scripts GROUP BY status) x),
  'income_7d', (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(commission),0) FROM conversions WHERE ts >= now() - interval '7 days'),
  'income_prev_7d', (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(commission),0) FROM conversions WHERE ts >= now() - interval '14 days' AND ts < now() - interval '7 days'),
  'income_30d', (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(commission),0) FROM conversions WHERE ts >= now() - interval '30 days'),
  'orders_7d', (SELECT COUNT(*)::int FROM conversions WHERE ts >= now() - interval '7 days'),
  'orders_prev_7d', (SELECT COUNT(*)::int FROM conversions WHERE ts >= now() - interval '14 days' AND ts < now() - interval '7 days'),
  'aov_7d', (SELECT COALESCE(ROUND(AVG(commission),0),0) FROM conversions WHERE ts >= now() - interval '7 days'),
  'posts_7d', (SELECT COUNT(*)::int FROM posts WHERE posted_at >= now() - interval '7 days'),
  'posts_by_platform', (SELECT json_agg(x) FROM (SELECT platform, COUNT(*)::int AS n FROM posts WHERE posted_at >= now() - interval '7 days' GROUP BY platform) x),
  'avg_score_7d', (SELECT COALESCE(ROUND(AVG(ai_score),1),0) FROM scripts WHERE ai_score IS NOT NULL AND updated_at >= now() - interval '7 days'),
  'approval_rate_7d', (SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status IN ('rendered','approved','posted')) / COUNT(*), 1) END FROM scripts WHERE created_at >= now() - interval '7 days'),
  'drop_rate_7d', (SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status IN ('dropped','failed')) / COUNT(*), 1) END FROM scripts WHERE created_at >= now() - interval '7 days'),
  'income_daily_14d', (SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(x ORDER BY d), '[]'::json) FROM (SELECT to_char(date_trunc('day', ts),'YYYY-MM-DD') AS d, COALESCE(SUM(commission),0) AS v, COUNT(*)::int AS orders FROM conversions WHERE ts >= now() - interval '14 days' GROUP BY 1) x),
  'content_performance', (SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(x), '[]'::json) FROM (SELECT s.track, s.ai_score, EXTRACT(hour FROM p.posted_at)::int AS hour_post, p.platform, p.status, COALESCE(pm.plays,0) AS plays, COALESCE(pm.likes,0) AS likes, COALESCE(pm.comments,0) AS comments, COALESCE(pm.saves,0) AS saves, COALESCE(pm.shares,0) AS shares FROM posts p JOIN scripts s ON s.id = p.script_id LEFT JOIN post_metrics pm ON pm.post_id = p.id WHERE p.posted_at >= now() - interval '21 days' ORDER BY p.posted_at DESC LIMIT 20) x),
  'active_strategy', (SELECT json_build_object('version', version, 'changes', changes, 'health', health_score) FROM strategy WHERE active = true ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1),
  'top_products', (SELECT json_agg(x) FROM (SELECT title, score, status FROM products ORDER BY score DESC LIMIT 5) x)
) AS metrics;
